This comparison analyzes the distribution of patients included in the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) from its inception on October 1, 2022, through September 30, 2025, categorized by their contact patterns across three reporting periods [^src1]. The data reveals that the vast majority of patients maintained continuous engagement with the database. The leading category by a wide margin is patients with contact in all annual report periods, accounting for 33,795 individuals [^src1]. In stark contrast, the trailing category is patients with contact exclusively in the 2023 annual report, representing only 1,960 individuals [^src1]. 

Other notable contact patterns include patients with contact only in the 2024 report (6,683) and only in the 2025 report (5,762) [^src1]. Among those with contact in exactly two periods, the 2023+2024 combination had 3,620 patients, the 2024+2025 combination had 4,230, and one entry for the 2023+2025 combination recorded 3,941 patients [^src1]. Additionally, 4,723 patients were recorded under the specific combination of 2023+2024+2025 [^src1]. An apparent data anomaly exists in the source table, as the category for contact only in the 2023+2025 report period is listed twice with differing values: once with 3,941 patients and again with 2,142 patients [^src1]. Because this comparison is derived from a single dated table section, no longitudinal trends across multiple reporting years can be established from this specific dataset [^src1].
